integrity: Standalone standard-library Python verifier reproduces all 240 canonical logical types, nine minimal representatives and 81 independent EF games; the mathematical reduction, not finite sampling, covers unbounded orders.
scientific_limitations: Proof combines a symbolic three-round game reduction with exact enumeration of 240 canonical cases. No higher-rank or arbitrary-tree classification is claimed; exact coverage of unindexed prior work is not guaranteed.
scientific_scope: Finite simple undirected trees of diameter exactly four in the pure equality-and-adjacency first-order signature; quantifier rank at most three.
title: Nine rank-three theories of finite diameter-four trees, with a sharp ten-vertex kernel
